اعترضنا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَرَضْنَا (iʕtaraḍnā) /iʕ.ta.radˤ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# اُعْتُرِضْنَا (uʕturiḍnā) /uʕ.tu.ridˤ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
